question: Can a nine-slot dormant associative memory repair stale representations after a hidden global cue-target reassignment using only observed live-key prediction feedback?
hypothesis: Once active cues supply consistent evidence of a +2 change, a uniform observed-feedback correction to dormant values may reduce post-switch stale recall without harming stable-memory accuracy, while preserving the same storage capacity.
freeze: Identical 12-episode active schedule and switch rule of Y033 on new distinct SHA256-keyed seeds72..79, bounded intervention rule, no heldout-tuned thresholds or hidden oracle calls. No retuning/first-use reruns.
world: 16 motifs, four-valued associations via frozen evaluator-only SHA256('Y033/'+seed+'/'+motif) first byte modulo4; seven active per episode, max nine dormant. STABLE means no change; SWITCH globally adds 2 modulo4 at episode6 only.
arms: unmodified_cache: read dormant 9-slot memories; learn feedback for 7 current cues at every episode; do not adjust unseen dormant values

feedback_repair: same capacity/write schedule, same dormant reads; if multiple or any live-overlap cues observed in consecutive episodes all provide the exact same nonzero modular label delta, after current feedback adjust all still-dormant values by that delta modulo4; no future labels or dormant-value oracle
time_order: Predict current seven keys first using last active knowledge, else dormant cache, else guess0; then observe only current seven targets. Evaluate consistency of label delta exclusively on keys live in both current and previous episode; update active associations and nine dormant cache. Apply correction AFTER feedback and AFTER inserting newly inactive previous observed keys. A correction is a separate maintenance mutation and its cost is recorded; no additional cache slots.
measures: Per heldout seed and condition total correct predictions, post-switch episodes7-11 correct, post-switch dormant-return predictions, detected correction events, number of dormant values rewritten, active overlap size, cache write parity and capacity.
classification: OBSERVED_REPAIR_BENEFIT if feedback_repair has strictly more post-switch correct predictions on SWITCH than unmodified_cache without lowering STABLE correct count, and any correction events are exclusively evidence-triggered; HARM if worse post-switch, otherwise NEUTRAL_MIXED.
safeguards: Evaluator computes targets only after predictions; policy only sees observed live feedback and never target function or future cue labels. SHA256 input cohort uniqueness, deterministic double-run, original archive and one full regression. No state storage beyond seven live+nine dormant; count extra maintenance operations as compute cost.
claim_limit: Synthetic uniform value-shift repair under predeclared hypothesis and observed feedback; not general developmental learning or neural consolidation.
